truths: One real CLI path reads FileSource once, normalizes, counts, orders, limits and returns a complete static UTF-8 HTML document; text/json use the same ranking.
Counter insertion order represents normalized first occurrence; repeated occurrences do not move it; stable descending-count sort precedes top.
Zoo apple APPLE zoo banana at top1 yields zoo2; top2 yields zoo2/apple2 in every format.
Basename only and pre-top total occur above the table; no parent path occurs anywhere in HTML.
Empty HTML retains basename, total0, three headers and zero data rows; empty text is empty and JSON is [] plus one newline.
Dynamic words and basename round-trip as escaped text, never data-derived markup, attributes, CSS or URLs.
UI-01 E1 overflow: fixed h1 naturally wraps within both 1280 and 320 CSS px viewports without truncation.
UI-02 E1 long-text: the complete fixed heading is readable at both widths without clipping.
UI-05 E3 empty: approved empty copy is outside tbody; three headers, total0 and zero data rows remain.
UI-06 E3 loading: only a completed static document is emitted, without loading HTML, spinner or skeleton.
UI-08 E3 populated: normal/top fixtures show the fixed word/count/order/rank/total expectations.
UI-09 E3 partial: top intentionally limits complete rows, while total covers the full input; no partial-result state is emitted.
